label: Peerdom
description: Manage peers, roles, circles, role holders and projects

operations.name: get_tenant
operations.description: Get the organization selected by this API key, including its palette and live map.

operations.name: list_maps
operations.description: List organization maps, including draft and archived metadata.

operations.name: list_peers
operations.description: List a page of active peers, optionally including former peers and custom fields.

operations.name: get_peer
operations.description: Get a peer, optionally including roles, former peers and custom fields.

operations.name: create_peer
operations.description: Create a peer. An email links/provisions an account as a guest; no invitation is sent.

operations.name: update_peer
operations.description: Update supplied peer profile fields. Access permissions are managed in Peerdom's UI.

operations.name: delete_peer
operations.description: Delete a peer from this organization.

operations.name: list_roles
operations.description: List roles from the live map or a selected map. A peer filter overrides the group filter.

operations.name: get_role
operations.description: Get a role from a live or draft map, with optional related data.

operations.name: create_role
operations.description: Create a role in a selected map and parent circle.

operations.name: update_role
operations.description: Update supplied fields on a role in a live or draft map.

operations.name: delete_role
operations.description: Delete a role from a live or draft map, excluding archived maps.

operations.name: assign_role
operations.description: Assign an existing role to a peer, optionally setting contribution, focus and election end.

operations.name: unassign_role
operations.description: Remove one peer's role assignment.

operations.name: get_role_holder
operations.description: Get one peer's role assignment details.

operations.name: update_role_holder
operations.description: Update supplied assignment fields. Peerdom documents percentage as a string for this endpoint.

operations.name: list_groups
operations.description: List groups (circles) in the live or selected map, optionally filtered by peer.

operations.name: get_group
operations.description: Get one group (circle) with optional custom fields.

operations.name: create_group
operations.description: Create a group (circle) in a selected map and parent circle.

operations.name: update_group
operations.description: Update supplied group (circle) fields.

operations.name: delete_group
operations.description: Delete a group from a live or draft map, excluding archived maps.

operations.name: list_projects
operations.description: List projects. With a peer filter Peerdom ignores pagination and returns that peer's projects.

operations.name: get_project
operations.description: Get one project.

operations.name: create_project
operations.description: Create a project; requires the Projects app.

operations.name: update_project
operations.description: Patch only supplied project fields; requires the Projects app. Renaming regenerates the slug.
